newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MARKET CAUTIOUS, H1 RESULTS BOOST HANSA, HOIU.
newsitem.headline: MARKET CAUTIOUS, H1 RESULTS BOOST HANSA, HOIU.

text.p: * Morning trade was 13 million kroons
* The Talse on-line index was up 0.34 percent to 279.99.
* Hansapank was the most active stock with 4.3
million kroons traded to be higher at 150.25/151.75 kroons vs
149.40 kroons.
* Hoiupank registered 4.1 million kroons on a
higher spread of 154.25/155.25 vs 154 kroons.
* Forekspank traded 2.2 million kroons on a higher
spread of 196/196.75 vs 194.75 kroons.
* Dealers said trade in Hoiu and Hansa was boosted by sound
half-year results but activity was low as many investors were
still on the sidelines.
(A complete report follows)
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
Half-year results boosted
Hansapank and Hoiupank on the Tallinn bourse in early Friday
trade but dealers saw low activity as many investors stayed on
the sidelines.
Hansapank, which published half year results and said it
would revise its profit estimate after group results, was the
most active stock with 4.3 million kroons traded to be higher at
150.25/151.75 kroons compared to 149.40 kroons.
Hoiupank, which announced a record profit for June, was
higher on a spread of 154.25/155.25 compared to 154 kroons.
Forekspank was also up on a spread of 196/196.75 vs 194.75
kroons. Dealers said the market was waiting for its first-half
results.
Tallinna Pank, which hit the headlines over news it wants to
buy 100 percent of Latvian Saules Bank, slipped lower to
62.70/62.95 from 63.10 but trade was a low 450,000 kroons.
On the free market, Rakvere took 392,000 kroons in
trade to be stable to higher at 12.90/13.20 compared to 13.00.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201,
reuters@reuters.ee
